records.source: Recruitment analysis only: columns to regress out of the recruitment ratio (ANCOVA with a pooled within-condition slope), adding a recruitment_adjusted column per object and per well. Only list variables the condition does not itself cause; a mediator such as vacuole size would remove the true effect together with the artifact. The fitted slopes are written to results/covariate_model.csv. None disables adjustment. Default None.
records.translation: 仅用于募集分析：从募集比率中回归去除的列（采用合并组内斜率的 ANCOVA），并为每个对象和每个孔添加一列 recruitment_adjusted。只应列出不由条件本身引起的变量；像液泡大小这样的中介变量会把真实效应连同伪影一起去除。拟合的斜率写入 results/covariate_model.csv。设为 None 时不进行校正。默认值为 None。

records.source: Recruitment analysis with adjust_covariates or confounder_covariates: model the log of the recruitment ratio, which suits multiplicative effects, and back-transform the adjusted value. False models the raw ratio. Default True.
records.translation: 在设置 adjust_covariates 或 confounder_covariates 的募集分析中：对募集比率的对数建模，适用于乘性效应，并将校正后的值反变换回原尺度。设为 False 时对原始比率建模。默认值为 True。

records.source: Recruitment analysis only: columns to screen as possible confounders of the recruitment ratio across conditions, for example n_cells_field, n_pathogens_field, pathogens_per_cell_field, cell_area or a pathogen intensity. Each is tested for a within-condition slope and for uneven spread across conditions; the table is written to results/confounder_report.csv. Field density columns are attached automatically. None skips the screen. Default None.
records.translation: 仅用于募集分析：作为募集比率在各条件间可能混杂因素加以筛查的列，例如 n_cells_field、n_pathogens_field、pathogens_per_cell_field、cell_area 或某个病原体强度。每列都会检验是否存在组内斜率以及在各条件间的分布是否不均；结果表写入 results/confounder_report.csv。视野密度列会自动附加。设为 None 时跳过筛查。默认值为 None。

records.source: Remove the columns Feature QC flags from the cell, cytoplasm, nucleus and pathogen tables of measurements.db at the end of the run, before profiling reads them. Every complete run lists all-missing, mostly-missing, numerically zero, constant and spike-dominated columns in feature_qc.csv and feature_qc.json beside measurements.db; this only decides whether they are also dropped. Removal cannot be undone. Default False.
records.translation: 在运行结束、谱分析读取之前，从 measurements.db 的细胞、细胞质、细胞核和病原体测量表中删除特征 QC 标记的列。每次完整运行都会在 measurements.db 旁的 feature_qc.csv 和 feature_qc.json 中列出全部缺失、大部分缺失、数值上为零、恒定以及由尖峰主导的列；此设置只决定是否同时删除它们。删除无法撤销。默认值为 False。

records.source: Recruitment analysis with field_qc: the per-field density columns tested against the MAD limit. Choose from n_cells_field, n_pathogens_field and pathogens_per_cell_field. Default ['n_pathogens_field', 'pathogens_per_cell_field'].
records.translation: 在设置 field_qc 的募集分析中：对照 MAD 限值进行检验的逐视野密度列。可从 n_cells_field、n_pathogens_field 和 pathogens_per_cell_field 中选择。默认值为 ['n_pathogens_field', 'pathogens_per_cell_field']。

records.source: Recruitment analysis with field_qc: fields whose parasites per host cell exceed this absolute ceiling are dropped, in addition to the MAD limit. None means no absolute ceiling. Default None.
records.translation: 在设置 field_qc 的募集分析中：每个宿主细胞的寄生虫数超过此绝对上限的视野会被丢弃，此规则独立于 MAD 限值之外另行生效。设为 None 表示没有绝对上限。默认值为 None。

records.source: Recruitment analysis with field_qc: fields with fewer host cells than this are dropped as too sparse to be informative. None disables this test. Default 10.
records.translation: 在设置 field_qc 的募集分析中：宿主细胞数少于此值的视野因过于稀疏、无法提供有效信息而被丢弃。设为 None 时禁用此检验。默认值为 10。

records.source: How a nucleus's reads become its guide. 'mapped' matches every read to the guide library first and votes among the reads that matched, so one clean read is enough and a read with a wrong base is left out instead of splitting the vote. 'agree' is the earlier rule: at least two reads must agree on their raw called string before it is matched. On the Funk et al. 2022 plates 'mapped' assigned about twice as many nuclei at a lower decoy match rate. Without a library the rule is 'agree'. Default 'mapped'.
records.translation: 细胞核的读段如何确定其引导 RNA。'mapped' 先将每个读段与引导 RNA 库匹配，再在匹配成功的读段之间投票，因此一个干净的读段就足够，含错误碱基的读段会被排除，而不会分散投票。'agree' 是较早的规则：至少两个读段的原始判定序列必须一致，之后才进行匹配。在 Funk et al. 2022 的板上，'mapped' 分配的细胞核约为两倍，且诱饵匹配率更低。没有引导 RNA 库时规则为 'agree'。默认值为 'mapped'。

records.source: How each base channel is placed onto the reference cycle. 'spots' registers the channel on its reads, with the cell background filtered away, wherever that disagrees with the background registration by more than 2 pixels; 'background' trusts the background alone, the earlier behaviour. On the Funk et al. 2022 plates the background registration left one cycle of each weak well at zero shift while it had drifted 10 to 25 pixels, and that cycle carried most of the well's base-call errors. Default 'spots'.
records.translation: 每个碱基通道如何配准到参考循环上。'spots' 在滤除细胞背景后依据该通道的读段进行配准，适用于其与背景配准相差超过 2 像素的情况；'background' 仅依赖背景配准，即较早的行为。在 Funk et al. 2022 的板上，背景配准使每个弱信号孔中的一个循环保持零位移，而该循环实际已漂移 10 至 25 像素，且该孔大部分碱基判读错误都出自这个循环。默认值为 'spots'。

records.source: Genes whose name starts with this are the non-targeting controls every feature is normalised against, well by well. Default 'nontargeting'. Alpha.
records.translation: 名称以此开头的基因为非靶向对照，所有特征都按孔逐一以其为基准进行归一化。默认值为 'nontargeting'。Alpha。

records.source: How the base caller undoes dye bleed-through between the four channels, after each cycle is put on a common scale. 'argmax_median' fits one unmixing from the median of the spots each channel wins, the method brieflow uses; on the Funk et al. 2022 plates it raised the share of reads matching a guide exactly and lowered the decoy match rate. 'none' calls the brightest normalised channel as it stands, the earlier caller. 'median' and 'percentile' are two older unmixing fits kept for comparison. Default 'argmax_median'.
records.translation: 在将每个循环调整到共同尺度后，碱基判读器如何消除四个通道之间的染料串色。'argmax_median' 依据每个通道胜出的斑点的中位数拟合一个解混矩阵，这是 brieflow 所用的方法；在 Funk et al. 2022 的板上，它提高了与引导 RNA 完全匹配的读段比例，并降低了诱饵匹配率。'none' 直接判定归一化后最亮的通道，即较早的判读器。'median' 和 'percentile' 是两种较早的解混拟合方法，保留用于比较。默认值为 'argmax_median'。

records.source: The guide design table, with sgRNA and gene_symbol columns. The aggregate phase matches each decoded barcode prefix to its guide and gene through it; prefixes two genes share are dropped and counted. Default None. Alpha.
records.translation: 引导 RNA 设计表，包含 sgRNA 和 gene_symbol 列。聚合阶段通过它将每个解码的条形码前缀匹配到对应的引导 RNA 和基因；两个基因共享的前缀会被丢弃并计数。默认值为 None。Alpha。

records.source: How far, in sequencing pixels, a phenotype nucleus may land from a sequencing nucleus after alignment and still be called the same cell. Wider merges more cells and more wrong ones, which give a phenotype the wrong guide. Default 4, under half a 10X nucleus diameter. Alpha.
records.translation: 比对后，表型细胞核与测序细胞核之间的距离（以测序像素计）在多大范围内仍可判定为同一个细胞。范围越宽，合并的细胞越多，错误合并也越多，从而使表型被赋予错误的引导 RNA。默认值为 4，不到 10X 细胞核直径的一半。Alpha。

records.source: The share of a nucleus's counted reads its guide must hold, with no tie for first. Lower assigns nuclei whose reads are split between two guides, which is where doublets and reads from a neighbour end up. Default 0.6.
records.translation: 细胞核计入的读段中，其引导 RNA 必须占有的比例，且第一名不得并列。降低该值会分配读段分散在两个引导 RNA 之间的细胞核，而双细胞和来自邻近细胞的读段正是落在这种情况。默认值为 0.6。

records.source: How many reads a nucleus needs before it may be assigned: library-matched reads under 'mapped', any reads under 'agree'. Raising it trades nuclei for certainty. Empty takes the rule's own value, 1 for 'mapped' and 2 for 'agree'. Default None.
records.translation: 细胞核在可被分配之前所需的读段数：在 'mapped' 下为与文库匹配的读段，在 'agree' 下为任意读段。提高该值是以减少细胞核换取确定性。留空时采用规则自身的值，'mapped' 为 1，'agree' 为 2。默认值为 None。

records.source: A cell is called mitotic when its nuclear mean DAPI intensity is this many robust standard deviations above its well's median and its nucleus is no larger than the median: condensed chromatin. Lower calls more cells mitotic. Default 3. Alpha.
records.translation: 当细胞的细胞核平均 DAPI 强度高于其所在孔中位数此数目的稳健标准差，且其细胞核不大于中位数时，该细胞被判定为有丝分裂细胞：即染色质凝缩。值越低，判定为有丝分裂的细胞越多。默认值为 3。Alpha。

records.source: How many image tiles Cellpose evaluates at once. Larger is faster on a graphics card until its memory runs out; on the CPU it changes little. Default 8. Alpha.
records.translation: Cellpose 一次评估的图块数。在显卡上，值越大速度越快，直至显存耗尽；在 CPU 上影响不大。默认值为 8。Alpha。

records.source: Which phenotype channel outlines the cells; DAPI is added as the second channel. A cytoskeletal stain that fills the cell gives whole cells, a membrane-only stain gives rims. Default 'AF750', phalloidin on the reference plate. Alpha.
records.translation: 用于勾勒细胞轮廓的表型通道；DAPI 作为第二通道加入。充满整个细胞的细胞骨架染料可得到完整细胞，仅标记细胞膜的染料则只得到边缘。默认值为 'AF750'，即参考板上的鬼笔环肽。Alpha。

records.source: Expected cell diameter in full-resolution phenotype pixels, as for the nucleus diameter. Default None. Alpha.
records.translation: 以全分辨率表型像素计的预期细胞直径，用法与细胞核直径相同。默认值为 None。Alpha。

records.source: The Cellpose model that segments phenotype cells on the cell channel plus DAPI. The same name as the nucleus model loads the model once. Default 'cpsam'. Alpha.
records.translation: 在细胞通道加 DAPI 上分割表型细胞的 Cellpose 模型。若与细胞核模型同名，则该模型只加载一次。默认值为 'cpsam'。Alpha。

records.source: The phenotype channels in the order the cell table names them, separated by commas, matched against the channel tokens of the phenotype file names. Each becomes the channel part of its intensity columns, so nucleus_dapi_mean_intensity is DAPI. On the reference plate GFP is tubulin, A594 is gamma-H2AX and AF750 is phalloidin. Default 'DAPI,GFP,A594,AF750'. Alpha.
records.translation: 按细胞表中命名顺序排列的表型通道，以逗号分隔，并与表型文件名中的通道标记匹配。每个通道成为其强度列名中的通道部分，因此 nucleus_dapi_mean_intensity 对应 DAPI。在参考板上，GFP 为微管蛋白，A594 为 gamma-H2AX，AF750 为鬼笔环肽。默认值为 'DAPI,GFP,A594,AF750'。Alpha。

records.source: Segment each phenotype field block-averaged by this factor and scale the masks back up. 2 keeps a 20X nucleus about 20 pixels across and costs a quarter of full resolution; 1 is full resolution; 4 is about the sequencing resolution and blockier outlines. Measurement always uses the full-resolution pixels. Default 2. Alpha.
records.translation: 将每个表型视野按此因子进行块平均后再分割，并将掩膜放大回原尺寸。2 使 20X 细胞核宽约 20 像素，耗时为全分辨率的四分之一；1 为全分辨率；4 约等于测序分辨率，轮廓更呈块状。测量始终使用全分辨率像素。默认值为 2。Alpha。

records.source: Expected nucleus diameter in full-resolution phenotype pixels. Set, the field is rescaled so it becomes the size the model expects; empty lets the model decide. Default None. Alpha.
records.translation: 以全分辨率表型像素计的预期细胞核直径。设置后，视野会被重新缩放，使细胞核达到模型预期的大小；留空则由模型自行决定。默认值为 None。Alpha。

records.source: The Cellpose model that segments phenotype nuclei on DAPI. 'cpsam' runs the installed Cellpose's default model; any other name is loaded as that model. Default 'cpsam'. Alpha.
records.translation: 在 DAPI 上分割表型细胞核的 Cellpose 模型。'cpsam' 运行已安装 Cellpose 的默认模型；其他任何名称都会作为相应模型加载。默认值为 'cpsam'。Alpha。

records.source: Restrict the phenotype phases to these sites, as '520-525,555'. Used for a pilot on part of a well; empty runs every placed field. Default None. Alpha.
records.translation: 将表型阶段限制在这些位点上，格式如 '520-525,555'。用于对孔的一部分进行试运行；留空时处理所有已定位的视野。默认值为 None。Alpha。

records.source: Add the GLCM homogeneity texture block to every channel of every compartment. It adds about ten percent to measurement time. Default True. Alpha.
records.translation: 为每个区室的每个通道添加 GLCM 同质性纹理特征组。这会使测量时间增加约百分之十。默认值为 True。Alpha。

records.source: How many wrong bases one read may carry and still be matched to its guide under the 'mapped' rule; a read equally close to two guides is never matched. 0 keeps exact matches only, which on a library whose guides differ at two positions is what keeps wrong guides rare: allowing 1 raised the decoy match rate about twelve-fold for a few percent more nuclei. A cycle that was not read is an unknown base, not a mismatch. Default 0.
records.translation: 在 'mapped' 规则下，一个读段最多可含多少个错误碱基仍能匹配到其引导 RNA；与两个引导 RNA 距离相同的读段永远不会被匹配。0 只保留完全匹配；对于引导 RNA 之间在两个位置上不同的文库，这正是使错误引导 RNA 保持罕见的原因：允许 1 个错配只多得到百分之几的细胞核，却使诱饵匹配率变为原来的约十二倍。未读取的循环视为未知碱基，而非错配。默认值为 0。

records.source: Under the 'mapped' rule, the base-call quality a nucleus needs when ONE library-matched read is all it has: that read's weakest cycle, as the margin between its brightest and second channel, 0 to 1. Nuclei with two or more agreeing reads are not affected. 0.03 halved the decoy matches on the Funk et al. 2022 plates for under half a percent of the nuclei; 0 admits every one-read nucleus. Default 0.03.
records.translation: 在 'mapped' 规则下，当细胞核仅有一个与文库匹配的读段时所需的碱基判读质量：即该读段最弱的循环中最亮通道与第二亮通道之间的差值，范围 0 到 1。拥有两个或更多一致读段的细胞核不受影响。在 Funk et al. 2022 的板上，0.03 以不到百分之零点五的细胞核为代价使诱饵匹配减半；0 则接纳所有单读段细胞核。默认值为 0.03。

records.key: How the phenotype acquisition is measured and joined to the sequencing calls: which channels are measured, which channel and models segment the cells and nuclei and at what size, how far a phenotype nucleus may lie from a sequencing nucleus and still be the same cell, and how the guide design, the non-targeting controls and the bootstrap turn cells into per-guide and per-gene results.
records.source: How the phenotype acquisition is measured and joined to the sequencing calls: which channels are measured, which channel and models segment the cells and nuclei and at what size, how far a phenotype nucleus may lie from a sequencing nucleus and still be the same cell, and how the guide design, the non-targeting controls and the bootstrap turn cells into per-guide and per-gene results.
records.translation: 表型采集如何测量并与测序读出关联：测量哪些通道，哪个通道和哪些模型以何种尺寸分割细胞和细胞核，表型细胞核与测序细胞核相距多远仍视为同一个细胞，以及引导 RNA 设计、非靶向对照和自助法如何将细胞转化为每个引导 RNA 和每个基因的结果。

retired_records.source: Bootstrap replicates for each gene's P value against non-targeting guides of the same sizes, with Benjamini-Hochberg FDR. 0 skips the test; 1000 resolves P values to about 0.001 and costs minutes per plate. Default 0. Alpha.
retired_records.translation: 针对相同数目的非靶向引导 RNA，计算每个基因 P 值所用的 bootstrap 重复次数，并采用 Benjamini-Hochberg FDR。0 表示跳过该检验；1000 可将 P 值分辨到约 0.001，每块板耗时数分钟。默认值为 0。Alpha。
